provenance.standard: Schema checks for ML data (Breck et al. 2019)
provenance.citation: Breck et al. (2019) Data Validation for Machine Learning, SysML
provenance.pitfall: A '?' or 'n/a' standing for missing turns a number column into text, so a model reads every number as its own category.
corner_cases: 'NA' can be a value (Namibia's country code), so it is never marked without a person saying so.
A sentinel like -1 or 999 reads as a number, so it never shows here; the outlier rule sees it.
Marking replaces fixed strings and fits nothing, so it runs before the split, on all rows.
Marking leaves the column as text; the wrong-types rule then reads it as numbers.
Placeholders are matched without the spaces around them (' ?' in UCI Adult) and marked exactly as written.

alternatives.label: Mark as missing
alternatives.description: Placeholder values in mostly numeric text columns become missing, in a step added before the split.
alternatives.rationale: The values stand for a gap, so missing is their true meaning. Only whole values on the known list are marked.

alternatives.label: No markers
alternatives.description: Leave the values as they are.
alternatives.rationale: No mostly numeric text column holds a known placeholder.

verification.invariant: No Gate B check exists yet. Planned: the marked values are fixed strings from the known list or named by a person, never learned from the target.
